outcome: Complications (visceral organ injury, wound infection, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: 21 patients who underwent uterine segmental resection during cesarean section with a preliminary diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum at Ege University between January 2017 and December 2018
finding: Uterine sparing surgery with segmental resection technique appears to be a safe and effective method for managing placenta accreta spectrum, with low complication rates.
